title: Great Sundering
wikitext:
The '''Great Sundering''' was a cataclysmic event which reshaped the world approximately 10,000 years ago, at the end of the [[War of the Ancients]], when the [[Well of Eternity]] was destroyed.

Prior to the Sundering, there was only one continent on Azeroth, referred to as [[Kalimdor]].  In the catastrophic explosion, eighty percent of the land mass was destroyed, leaving the major continents and scattered islands known today: [[Northrend]], [[Undermine]], the [[Eastern Kingdoms]], and the remnant still referred to as [[Kalimdor]].

The site of the Well of Eternity became a swirling vortex of power, known as the [[Maelstrom]].
